{{Infobox/Character |shop = Yes |location = [[Village]] |location_page_description = Allows the player to upgrade their {{Item|Personal Bank}}. |x= 51.5 |y= 78 |z= 20.5 }} '''Guy''' is an [[NPC]] located in the {{Zone|Village}}, in a small cave, close to the {{Zone|Mountain}}. He offers players the {{Item|Personal Bank}} and its upgrades. == Stock == Guy provides the {{Item|Personal Bank}} and its upgrades, granting remote access to the {{Zone|Bank}}. These will come in good use!}} |- |class="ct" |Denying |{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] &aGuy&f: Oh man gee, that's awful man, call me when you got 'em alright?}} |} == Trivia == * Guy's name references to the real life person [[w:Guy_Fawkes|Guy Fawkes]]. [[w:Guy_Fawkes_mask|The mask]], depicted in '''Guy''''s skin, was designed after Guy Fawkes centuries after for the graphic novel [[w:V for Vendetta|V for Vendetta]]. **The mask was designed based on the effigies of Guy Fawkes, which are ceremonially burned in Great Britain since 1606. * Guy's skin behind his mask is a normal Steve skin with white eyes, similar to [[mcw:Herobrine|Herobrine]]. *After unlocking all upgrades, the tooltip in '''Guy''''s UI will display as ''Hackerman''. **This is likely a reference to the fact that Guy Fawkes mask has been used by a hacktivist group [[w:Anonymous (group)|Anonymous]], who use it as a symbol since 2008. == History == {{History table |ahn= {{History|2026/Jan 30|Moved '''Guy''' from {{Coords|51.5|79|-13.5}} to {{Coords|51.5|78|20.5}}, due to the redesign of the [[Hub Island]].}} |beta= {{History|0.7.2|[[File:Guy.png|26px]] Added '''Guy'''.}} {{History|0.24.2|Moved '''Guy''' from {{Coords|51.5|79|-13.5}} to {{Coords|51.5|78|20.5}}, due to the redesign of the [[Hub Island]].}} }} == Navigation == {{Nav/Characters}}
